title: Verify disk-capacity measurements through Windows output-directory junctions
outcome: The actual Windows/libuv capacity observation through cross-volume junctions or symlinks is established, and any limitation is covered by a safe measurement or clear documentation.
acceptance: A contained fixture or primary implementation inspection determines which filesystem native statfs measures for an existing cross-volume output junction and a missing descendant.
If the current measurement can report the link volume instead of the output volume, a guarded realpath-based remedy or explicit documented limitation is implemented and verified.
No cleanup follows reparse points and no fixture writes outside the repository's authorized locations.
